caption:
La Ventana is one of the best kite surfing destinations in the world.

From November through April, the Coromuel wind fills the bay with colour — kites everywhere, riders of every level, the Sea of Cortez stretching out behind them. The La Ventana kite school is five minutes south of the property. Gear rental, lessons, guides. Everything you need.

And when the wind drops? The same bay goes glass-flat, warm, and clear. Perfect for paddleboarding, kayaking, or just floating.

Stay at The Moroccan Palace. Everything La Ventana offers is right outside.

Book at themoroccanpalace.com
